description: Gave the arrest back in four voices.
name: Arthur Meeks

description: Marked Kemp in the ring, and the back in the fourth hour.
name: Augustine Phillips

description: Stood behind the points and hat-bands, and affected not to know any players.
name: Gilbert Shakespeare

description: Stood through three shows of the crown knocked off and set on again.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Chose a whistle over a knife, and ate pig until Phillips took the bone.
name: Sam Latchet

description: Said nobody liked to ask Burbage as whom, and sent the gingerbread home to Alse.
name: Thomas Pope

description: Danced for nothing in a ring of two hundred, and bowed.
name: Will Kemp

description: Spoke to Gilbert, and bought three gingerbread men, one with gilt.
name: William Shakespeare
